name: Westfield Century City
description: The ultimate destination for food, fashion and fun! Westfield Century City is a premier open-air shopping destination in the heart of Los Angeles, featuring over 200 world-class retailers, dining venues, and entertainment options. This completely reimagined center showcases luxury brands like Tiffany & Co., alongside popular favorites like Nordstrom and Bloomingdale's, plus acclaimed restaurants including Eataly and Din Tai Fung.
demographics: Westfield Century City attracts an affluent, fashion-forward demographic with household incomes predominantly exceeding $100,000 annually, drawing from the surrounding Beverly Hills, Bel Air, and West Los Angeles neighborhoods. The visitor base skews toward professionals aged 25-54 and high-income families who prioritize premium brands, experiential dining, and luxury shopping experiences. The trade area encompasses one of the most affluent zip codes in the United States, with shoppers demonstrating strong preference for designer brands, contemporary fashion, and upscale lifestyle offerings. The center appeals to both local residents seeking convenient luxury shopping and tourists visiting the Los Angeles area who desire a premium retail experience.
summary: An upscale open-air shopping destination in Los Angeles featuring luxury retailers, gourmet dining, and premium entertainment experiences.
